tasks.description: 1.1 Audit available prerequisite evidence and record unsatisfied authority-safe/discovery receipts; keep canonical evidence integration and release promotion gated while allowing independent experimental artifact validation.
1.2 Validate the dependency ledger, source-to-spec mapping, existing-owner boundaries, and core/full milestone graph; materialize a child change only when its implementation starts.
1.3 Define a small development scenario set for actual LLM use: claim mapping, additional assumptions, stale reviews, and missing evidence.
1.4 Add a usage-feedback template capturing task, exact commands/output, friction, workarounds, and suggested changes; keep correctness claims subject to source/Lean verification.
2.1 Add the versioned result-manifest schema with stable IDs, revision digests, document locators, claim/component inventory, coverage, and finite input limits.
2.2 Validate duplicate IDs, unsupported versions, required references, conflicting revisions, and one-to-many or many-to-one mappings with portable fixtures.

2.3 Resolve formal targets through existing canonical subject/source/environment identity owners; preserve ambiguous, unresolved, and stale links, including nonexistent supplied names and distinct article/archive/working-tree revisions from the fixed-epoch baseline.
2.4 Add independent correspondence reviews with reviewer kind, rationale, revision binding, and attributed difference records.
2.5 Preserve disputes and invalidate applicability of old reviews after either subject revision changes; test stronger hypotheses and weaker conclusions.
2.6 Expose and verify installed experimental `ladon result validate` behavior without loading or endorsing referenced checker evidence.
2.7 Record the full claim-correspondence exit only after canonical target resolution and prerequisite receipts are available.
3.1 Join manifests to existing theorem evidence and lineage without starting Lean, fetching URLs, or refreshing stored projections.
3.2 Represent hypotheses, axiom observations, declared external assumptions, placeholders, obligations, and external frontiers with distinct origin and coverage.
3.3 Preserve independent checking, freshness/environment, correspondence, exposition, and attribution dimensions through stored and derived projections.

3.4 Implement compact decision-oriented cards and exact drill-down references under the specified row, text, and byte limits; expose per-component conventional-only, unassessed, unresolved and reported-implication reasons, plus strict/closed and transcript/average-only differences. Version any required manifest extension explicitly.
3.5 Implement revision/query-bound pagination and JSON/text parity; test stale cursors, truncation, missing evidence, and unknown totals.
3.6 Add installed `ladon result inspect` scenarios for successful builds with unmapped claims, partial trust coverage, and historical replay evidence; record the dossier exit.

4.1 Define ordered guide steps with exact claim/declaration/source references, prerequisite annotations, purpose, author kind, and explanation revision; explain conditions, counterexamples and release-scope differences before supporting dependency navigation.
4.2 Reuse existing bounded lineage/derivation queries while keeping authored reading order separate from graph topology.
4.3 Add bibliographic identities, precise locators, relationship assertions, attribution disputes, and separate review scopes.
4.4 Invalidate exposition/citation review applicability after relevant edits without changing underlying checker evidence.
4.5 Expose installed `ladon result guide` and lemma-reuse navigation without implicit model calls or applicability claims; record the guide exit.
5.1 Define the core bundle profile and complete relative-path inventory; remap selected cache-backed evidence into portable artifact references.
5.2 Implement deterministic, allowlisted, byte-bounded atomic export while preserving disclosure omissions and previous output on failure.
5.3 Implement integrity-only verification and safe archive inspection/extraction with traversal, symlink, collision, expanded-size, and member-count fixtures.
5.4 Preserve predecessor revisions, historical reviews, optional supplied scholarly identifiers, and explicit missing replay dependencies.
5.5 Exercise `ladon result export|verify` plus dossier/guide inspection outside the original checkout and cache with network disabled; record the core bundle exit.
6.1 Assemble a tracked real-Lean fixture linking a precise claim, checked declaration, extra-assumption or incomplete-mapping case, stale review, and reusable lemma.
6.2 Package and install the candidate outside the source checkout; run the core dossier/guide/bundle scenario with explicit pinned checking and offline inspection.

6.3 Have an LLM attempt the development tasks through the ordinary CLI and retain exact commands, relevant outputs, failures, and workarounds; compare with frozen `baselines/fixed-epoch-v1` without rewriting its original outcomes. Its completed offline baseline does not satisfy this later core dossier/guide/bundle task.
6.4 Triage usage reports into reproducible usability findings and source/Lean-checked correctness findings without converting self-reported usefulness into measured benefit.
6.5 Fix confirmed first-use obstacles and rerun the affected scenarios; retain unresolved findings and capture coverage.
6.6 Record the local core feedback report and experimental readiness; defer held-out metrics and human-cohort comparisons to a separately scheduled evaluation effort.
7.1 Define reported/observed model, input/output, process-summary, tool-event, timing, and cost-estimate fields with explicit suppliers and capture methods.
7.2 Add separate problem, attempt, batch, selection-rationale, AI-involvement, and result-link records under the manifest limits.
7.3 Preserve success, failure, timeout, abandonment, and unassessed outcomes with exact criteria and evidence; avoid treating producer success labels as checker acceptance.
7.4 Implement capture-boundary coverage and denominator rules; test success-only imports, retries, exclusions, incomplete populations, and empty inventories.
7.5 Add disclosure states, explicit export selection, secret-omission fixtures, and separate identities for original output and edited exposition.
7.6 Integrate provenance inspection into dossier/bundle projections and record the provenance exit after portable and installed scenarios pass.
8.1 Locate and pin authoritative upstream contracts for the initial copyright/header, `formalization.yaml`, and comparator-challenge profile; record exact supported versions and coverage.
8.2 Implement optional profile presence/schema checks with unknown-version and unavailable-adapter diagnostics; keep core inspection usable.

8.3 Integrate explicitly supplied or explicitly requested comparator observations through existing execution/authority owners, preserving operation relation, subjects, environment, and not-run status.
8.4 Integrate provenance, optional existing capsules, community-profile observations, and external dependency disclosures into the full bundle without implicit replay or public submission.
8.5 Verify redacted-content exclusion, detached inspection, deterministic export, and distinct integrity/checking/correspondence outcomes; record the full bundle exit.
9.1 Extend qualitative usage scenarios to attribution support and incomplete attempt populations; record full feedback outcomes and limitations.
9.2 Generate capability-readiness records through the existing owner; do not promote external-benefit or human-understanding claims from LLM feedback alone.
9.3 Update product scope, CLI examples, evidence review guidance, and release documentation to distinguish core/full milestones and independent evidence/review axes.
9.4 Run all capability scenario tests, isolated installed-distribution gates on supported Python versions, and required real-Lean integration gates for authority-bearing operations.
9.5 Run strict Python quality, OpenSpec validation/hygiene, generated-contract consistency, source traceability, dependency-ledger, and whitespace checks.
9.6 Verify every prerequisite and core/full exit against compatible candidate identities, record the full acceptance report, and leave public repository deposition as a separate explicit operation.

instruction:
Recover the requested outcome and next useful result from the context files.
Work through tasks, run their completion checks, and record progress once.
Test consequential uncertain assumptions before expensive dependent work.
A failed probe stops expansion of that implementation; try a bounded alternative
within existing authorization, unchanged acceptance conditions, and the remaining
budget. Count all attempts against that budget. Keep capability tasks open until
their acceptance gates pass. Diagnose ordinary failures within scope; pause
when no viable authorized next step is available, naming the limiting dependency,
decision, or budget rather than treating one failed route as impossibility.
Report demonstrated outcomes and verification separately from checked tasks.
